documented_root_cause: Complaints are about delivery delay from a bottleneck, not product quality.
expected_first_action: Run a bottleneck/time study; the complaints are about wait time, not the product
unsafe_first_actions: Overhaul the product to fix complaints that are about delivery speed
expected_prioritization_rationale: A product overhaul will not fix complaints caused by delivery delays; relieve the bottleneck.
